literature_scope.role: Bhadra–Schweinberger v2 Condition 2 provides context for full-vector conditional exchangeability. Forastiere et al. author manuscript v4 Assumptions 2–3 and Theorem 1 provide a comparison with local joint-treatment adjustment. Sävje distinguishes exposure definitions from response assumptions.
limitations: The project derives its fixed-policy formulas under full-vector conditional exchangeability. Full uses positive support for the target assignment. Signature additionally requires all-assignment mean sufficiency and positive support for each positive-weight node's target signature.
Forastiere et al. identify a covariate-standardized local exposure response. Their assumptions and target do not directly establish either project fixed-policy formula.
Task 7 independently recomputed a representative Full case. For Signature, Task 7 reviewed the mathematical contract and native selection branch. A corresponding new runtime check remains pending.
